patterns.condition: LONG with DI+ > DI- gap >= 10 and ADX >= 30
patterns.recommendation: Prioritize LONG entries when DI+ exceeds DI- by 10+ points and ADX confirms trend strength above 30.

patterns.condition: SHORT with DI- > DI- gap >= 8 and ADX >= 27
patterns.recommendation: SHORT trades show no edge; avoid or require additional confirmation beyond DI positioning.

patterns.condition: LONG with RSI 49-60 and positive sentiment >= +0.15
patterns.recommendation: LONG trades in the 49-60 RSI zone with sentiment >= +0.15 demonstrate strong edge; avoid overbought RSI > 65 on LONG.
Avoid LONG entries when RSI exceeds 60; this creates a false strength signal and increases drawdown risk.
Avoid SHORT trades during weak trend conditions (ADX < 20); market lacks directional conviction.
High ADX + strong DI+ shows mixed results; confirm with RSI < 65 to avoid overbought reversals.

strongest_long_setup: LONG when DI+ > DI- by 10+ points, ADX 27-40, RSI 49-62, and sentiment >= +0.15. This combination achieved 73% win rate across strong sample size.
strongest_short_setup: SHORT trades lack consistent edge (50% or below across all tested conditions). Insufficient conviction to recommend; SHORT only as hedge against failed LONG entries.
summary: XRP LONG trades outperform SHORT significantly (67% win rate vs 44%), with the strongest setup combining moderate trend strength (ADX 27-40), clear directional dominance (DI+ gap 10+), mid-range momentum (RSI 49-62), and positive sentiment. Avoid LONG entries in overbought RSI > 60 territory where reversals spike; SHORT positions lack statistical edge and should be deprioritized.
